To begin with we didn't think they were going to work. We took the old filter out and put the new one in and could not get any water to come out. So we put the old one back in and same thing...no water (which it had been working fine). We tried anything and everything and nothing worked. Finally the next day I suggested to my husband that we unplug the refrigerator, that maybe something needed to reset itself. So we unplugged it and waited a few minutes, plugged it back in and we had water! They are working great. And the price is great too!
Perfect fit..great price...fast shipping...6 filters will last me about 3 years in the area in which I live that has very "hard" water.
Easy installation, no jerking required.  I didn't realize that the filter could actually make my fridge quitter, no more loud noises during the night.  I love these filters.
It's works perfectly.
Got these to replace the original equipment filter.  It installed very easy, even better than the original equipment and you get 6 for the price of one of the originals.
Doesn't filter everything out.  There is still a slight taste of chlorine in the water.  There is no problem with the installation of the filter, it goes in quite easily.
Fits no problems had for over a week no leaks and filters out the nasty taste of city water.

Can't bet the price  order it for a friend they work great

I buy the six pack because they cost so much less than at the store where I bought my fridge.
First time I've used these and I'd say so far, they're doing a good job. So far, I'd purchase again.

These are a GREAT price for the amount you get, and they do filter the water just fine... So why am I only giving it 3 stars?

Out of the 6 that I received 2 would not hold the seal, it would have a slow leak from the o-ring and pool in the back of my refrigerator. I couldn't see the water since my filter sits between two drawers. Over the course of a few hours I walked in to a big puddle in my kitchen on my hardwood floors. Once that happens you have to pull the filter then wait hours and hours for the rest of the water to make its way from inside the fridge to the floor.

This happend twice to me and each time the leak is never apparent from the installation. I will still watch but now I put down paper towels every time and check for leak, which is why its gets 3 stars. The other 4 worked awesome!

The ability to have cold water and ice available in the kitchen is a must.  Samsung filters recommends replacement every 300 gallons or Six months.  Buying individual filters cost a fortune.  Purchasing Tier1 slashes the cost without a compromising the quality.
Does what is expected
So far no leaks too early to tell how good they really are
Replacement filter for samsung 5 door refrigerator.  You get 6 filters for the price of one original samsung filter.
Item was identical to the one removed from the appliance. I am satisfied with these filters and plan to get another set soon

I had a nice review typed out but chrome decided to freeze, so here is the short version!

This is a great value for the money, much cheaper than the competing products. I had no issues reading the instructions and getting started. I washed a decent amount of clothing (Several pairs of socks, undergarments and T shirts) And they all came out smelling fresh, and pretty darn dry, even without hanging them up! I had no big issues with the product, except the powered drain. It didn't seem to supply enough power to drain out without raising the washer itself up a bit. Other than that, I am pleased with this purchase! I took a chance and don't regret it!

I will update this review if any issues arise!

The Della spin drying washong machine is fantastic. It has a large impeller, 2 speeds, a stainless steel rinse/spin basket large enough to handle its washer tub capacity, as well as the conventional timers and funtion controls.

I bought mine on Ebay and it is the same machine. What I want to note is that the spin drier really removes excess water, This cuts drying time by about 35%. Finally it is a pristine beauty in white and turquoise.

Machine works great. Only issue is hooking it up to water and drain.  the "U" drain hose is too narow to fit over a kitchen or bathroom sink. The water hse is odd.  it doesnt fit over either faucet.  A rubber und on both ends of the hose would help but, An adaptor most of the time will be needed.

Well, I saw the spinner timer didn't work when I tested the washer with the first small load. I thought I could deal with that. I'd just have to keep an eye on it. No problem. Then on the 4th load a few days later, the water pump stopped working. Both the spinner and the washer now have water in them. I'm not sure why the spinner does except maybe from the towel that I put into it. The spinner spins, but the water stays there, so nothing is going to get dry in it. I hoped this would be a solution for not having to go to the laundromat as often, but I seem to have gotten more problems than solutions.

UPDATE:
I contacted customer service and they were very professional and friendly. When I tried the washer again in order to send the seller a video to show the issues, the washer and dryer worked perfectly. The timer worked even though it had not worked at all since I got it. I'm not sure what happened. Maybe I didn't have the lids completely closed the first time? I don't know. lol But I'm updating this review, because everything is fine now and customer service was so great.
Great little washer and spin dryer! More than expected for the money! My only complaint is the cord and hoses are way to short! Shipped to me in 4 days! So very pleased overall with my purchase!

Not as easy as a fully automatic machine! That is the only negative you will get from me.
I am amazed at how clean our clothes are! The extra work is well worth the results. I put the washer right into the bath tub, and can do my laundry at my own pace. The spin dryer gets so much water out of the clothes, it really doesn't take long for them to dry. Everything goes into this washer, (jeans, sweatshirts, delicates, sheets, towels.....) and everything comes out great! For extra stained work jeans, I just run them through a couple of wash cycles, and I can see how much dirt and grime comes out. This machine is so much cheaper than using the community laundry machines, and does a much better job. Also, after reading reviews, I experimented with the amount of detergent to use. I only use about a tablespoon of detergent to wash a full load, saving on the cost of laundry supplies as well. Larger items like blankets, throws, and bedspreads still have to go to the laundry mat. I want to buy another machine so I have a back-up if anything happens to this one!
Nice Washing Machine, very useful and easy to use! Good product
Great product, I should have done more research. panda has a full automatic washer. For the price this one gets the jod done.
Love how easy it is to operate

This machine arrived today. I've washed five small loads of clothing since I got home from work. I use my own (handmade) washing powder and vinegar for rinsing and softening. This machine is going to help spend less time at the laundry mats! I don't have to worry about other people's laundry odors from fragrance heavy laundry products imbedding in my clothing and aggravating my allergies. It did clean my clothing very well. Yes, there's time involved but there would be the time involved if I could use my bigger washing machine, which broke last year. Because the spin dryer nearly dries the clothing, it takes less time in my dryer. In fact, I washed three loads and dried them all at once and in less time than I did when I washed my clothes in the big washer.

The pros:
The wash cycle was easily set.
The drain did work very well. I set the machine in the bathtub and it didn't have a problem draining.
The spin dryer has that handy little plastic "balancer" that actually helps keep the loads balanced.

The cons:
The fill hose does not fit my tub facet or my bathroom sink facet. But I used a small bucket to fill up the washer easily enough.
It does require more attention than you would give if you had a full-sized washer or had to go to a laundry mat but that's the trade-off.

What I learned:
I could wash two pairs of my husband's jeans easily without it slogging away. That meant I could also wash five of my tops
useful，good！

Where to even start with this washing machine...I'm a travel nurse and have an RV....one of the things I hate most is going to the laundromat...I did ALOT of research before finally ordering this machine...boy am I glad I did! This little baby spins my clothes out better than my home washing machine!! Yes it is a little labor intensive having a separate bin to wash and spin and I spin things out one or two at a time because the wash side holds more than the spin side but I wouldn't give this thing up....no way!! Even my Dad was impressed and that's not an easy sell :) Order one...you will be glad you did!!
I satisfied to use this

This product is a God-send as I am able to wash my clothes without having to wait on and juggle days to do so, as I currently live in an apartment. There are about 38 units in the apartment building I live in and they only have four washers and dryers. The units in my building range from 3 bedroom family apartments to one bedroom apartments. There are days when the machines breakdown and we are left with vying for 3 machines in the whole building, and to top it off the washing machine compartments are very very small, and for $2.25 (which was recently increased from $2.00) a load I was not willing to shell out the money. With this machine my clothes came out so clean, and the maintenance on the machine is minimal, and because the spinner spin dries my clothes so well all I need to do is hang the clothes in my portable dryer (Dr.Dryer) and my clothes come out as if they were dried in a regular commercial dryer. Before buying this machine I shopped around and I researched a lot of different machines. This machine appealed to me because it was cheaper than the others. I have only had the machine for 2 days now, and I can say I love it. I have washed towels, bed sheets, pillow cases, and all my clothes (that were dirty) in this machine and I am happy. I still have to take my comforters (queen size) to the washing machine, but, I don't mind one hang up concerning all of the perks that this machine comes with. I am really happy with my purchase.

I have only had this for a week or two so for those of you wondering if it is going to last i do not have that answer yet.

I love this machine. I live in an appartment and this saves me money. I dont have to pay $6+ for each load of laundy and gas to get to the laundry mat.

It takes me about 45mins to do a full basket of laundry. It isnt quiet but it's not too loud either. It gets my clothes just as clean as a normal machine would.

Only cons i see are sometimes the drainer doesnt want to work right, and it doesnt COMPLETELY drain the machine. (I have to lift the machine onto the toilet and tilt it to get all the water out of the hose and then i take a towl and wipe the inside out to avoid mold.)

I also love it because it is more environmentally friendly than big ones. I can cut down on my water usage.

As of now, remember i only had it 2 weeks, i would recommend it for anyone who lives in an apartment and has 3 or under people in their family. I only say 3 or less people because if you have more you will be spending all your spare time doing laundry....its not big enough.
Bought this product for my  daughter and she loves it.

This machine takes up fairly little space and does real good cleaning job with SMALL loads. The instructions were obviously written by non American (flawed in English). Found it easier to run the wash cycle again to remove the soap, rather then following the instructions of moving to spinner etc. way to cumbersome.
spinner is tricky to load , but if you pack them in nice and even and push down as you load them you can run it without bit trying to dance all over..Definately does spin dry very well.
Water pump does not always prime and you have to manually lower the hose to get it going, could use a better bdesign.

This little Washing machine is the BEST thing we have ever purchased that saves time and work. Before we purchased this washer we had to wash clothes in the kitchen sink by hand! Due to sensitivity to the scented products people used at the laundry mats, we could not use their machines! We are allergic to scented products! Since the washer arrived, we have washed about 16 loads with little effort. We have hooked the washer to the "laundry" room faucets with a "Y" hose connector we purchased on Amazon and connected the "Y" connector with a short piece of garden hose and extended the discharge hose about 6 inches to place into the wall mount drain. All this allows for fast fills without using the provided hose and mess free draining! We use two old fashion drying racks for drying cloths on. We would recommend this unit to anyone who cannot afford, have space, have Chemical Sensitivities for a full size Washer/Drier. If our unit ever quits working we WILL purchase another ASAP!!!!!!!!!

PS = It also saves us money from going to the laundry mat. Going to the laundry mat costs between $10.00 and $12.00 per week. This unit cost $117.00 after tax and free delivery with PRIME. So after about twelve (12) weeks I paid for the unit and I now wash clothes for pennies in water and electric costs. Life is good!

AMAZING! This machine is a mighty powerhouse washer/spin dry unit!
The video I watched did not do it justice!
Again, our applause to the genius innovators at Amazon, and their clientele!

Wish it had a bit larger capacity.  Everything works great.  It's fast and easy and portable.  I can see how it would be great for an apartment or a camper.  I don't mind ringing out the clothes before putting them in spinner (it's a negligible amount of work), and I like the fact that I can use both sides at the same time. With a  Dr. Dry (for things you need right away) and an umbrella dryer rack, you're set!  To make things go a little quicker, I use water buckets instead of a slow faucet, and I do laundry every day.  Using a "floating filter" is a good idea because it catches hair and lint when clothes are washing. It is also self-venting.

Love it! Didn't see the water marks at first so wasn't sure how much water to put in. Decided to be conservative my first try, only filled the tub about 1/4 up. This allowed me to wash 1 of Hubby's t-shirts, 1 boxer, 2 pair socks, and 3 of my undies, 2 pair socks, and threw in a wash cloth just because. It washed all this at which I finally found was the low water line. So I know I'll easily be able to fit a weeks worth of undergarments for the both of us at the high water level. Not sure if it will be able to do jeans. Could fit 3 pair in washer, but spin dryer would only fit 1 pair, and not sure, may be to heavy. Will see. Oh and I believe I put in too much detergent as I had to do two rinses, so will need to test a bit. Believe it will be just perfect for us in the motorhome! Agitation is good, spin is fast. Only down side I see is all lint and dog hair isn't removed, if I used a dryer that would do it, but I hang dried. So had to shake a little off.

We checked most of the compact washing machines. But compare to other similar product this is cheaper on Amazon with free shipping. And the shipping was really fast. We love this washing machine. This is small, compact and very powerful. You can clean decent amount of clothes at a time and it cleans well. The spinner is also very good and powerful. This is really very good for money!

This machine is the best thing I ever invested in.  I couldn't believe how awesome this washed my clothes. It takes some work but it is so worth the time. The hoses are very cheap which I'm planning to buy better ones but the hoses are working fine just very flimsy. I have 4 people in my home and this is perfect.

I just love this machine. I have figured out that the drain tube is to be connected to the side of the machine and I hooked it to my washing machine drain pipe. So if you have this machine at the same level as the drain pipe it works great. I have yet to try to attach a washing machine hose to it but plan to next week. It washes clothes cleaner than I imagined. It also holds more clothes and the spinner is amazing. It drys them very well. My test for this was my big heavy shower rug. It got it cleaner then it was before and the spinner had no problems. This washing machine is well worth the price and is a power house at cleaning your clothes.

Used it twice and so far so good.  It is almost too good to be true.  If it holds up and keeps on working so well, I will be very thrilled.  It is easy to use.  I use a different hose to fill it, because the one that came with does not work.  The machine must be filled a second time and put through a second wash, to get the soap out, before you can spin it.  Just use a small amount of soap.  You can wash without any soap, if cloths have been lightly worn. I hang clothes on hangers to dry, after they have been spun.  I may buy a small rack to set in the tub for drying overnight.  I will save a great deal of money with this machine.  It is not as convenient as a regular machine, because I have to lift the soaked clothes a little at a time for the spin cycle, and they tangle together badly.  the lint filter is not good, I ordered a floating filter to use instead,  but it gets the cloths clean and saves money.  So I will tell others about it and tell them to give it a try, although you must be really convinced, before you buy one, because the shipping cost to return it will drain your pocket book.  All in all, I am glad I bought it.

What a money saver. This machine is more powerful than you can believe! I live in a small apt with no w/d hook ups and dread, dread, dread going to any public laundromats! Basically this machine has replaced the laundromat for me. Wash your clothes, linens, towels, cleaning rags, whatever that will fit. I just put up a clothesline across my bedroom and my clothes are dry in no time with the ceiling fan on. I bought an adapter for the bathroom sink to fit a garden hose to fill it. And I use the commode as the drain. This unit fits nicely between the two. I can't say enough great things about this machine. Truly has been a blessing for me. It has already paid for itself.

Update 6/5/2017 This Della is a blessing to me!! I am disabled and on fixed income. The nearest rip off laundromat is miles away. I have had this machine now for 18 months and its working the same it did the first time I used it. I use it every single day. There is no way I could go to a laundromat as much as I wash. Sometimes she growls and bitches at me but I just give her a tummy rub and she quiets down. lol Thank you who ever engineered this machine! The only pitfall to this whole deal is hanging up damp laundry inside because of the humidity but that's why they invented Damprid. Plus with a fan, your laundry is dry in no time because the spinner has a Boeing jet engine.
Thank you .My son loved it.
WORKS WELL!  SMALL LOAD MACHINE.  I FEEL LIKE A CHILD WITH A NEW TOY!

The included booklet does not include information that it says it should. The water fill hose does not stay attached very well. And a riser is needed to assist with draining of the machine. As of 12/29/2016 the motor for the spinner died and the machine quite spinning. Have requested return label. There was no option to exchange for another machine, or request repair of the machine. Only option was request a refund with the return.
Its tiny, it cleans, fits in my bathroom, and its affordable! What more could I ask for?!

This machine works very well. It's when folks overload it that it doesn't clean well or it will give negative results. I have seen comments on these washers that make no sense.Like it doesn't spin right , well unload the spinner and even out the clothes and make sure you have the drain knob set on off  and try again. It's trial and error.  These are not $700 machines so you need to put a smaller amount in the machine along with a smaller amount of water. And You will get beautiful results. It is a little bit of extra work but hey beats going to the laundromat  and spending about $25 to wash a few loads. I have had these types of washers from many yrs ago and they are making a come back only smaller in size. I  loved mine then and I love this one now.  I just set it in the tub ,let it drain out there, works great.
It washed my clothes well enough, but after about a month it still smells like something is too hot.

Great product was at first disappointed for my girlfriend complaints about water not been disposed but they solve my problem best customer service then srn me right away cant complaint I understand sometimes items make come defected but don't necessary consist of all this a great washing machine works even better then a regular one trust me a good investment once you know how functions an to message bit to know its lil tricks once you do I'm sure you will enjoy

Iv had this little washer for about 6 months now. It's great for washing baby cloths and small items, just make sure to put clothes on a washable laundry mess bag or they will get tangled up. Great investment! Great for small apartments and doesn't use a lot of electricity.
its really nice and works for my purpose

I've had this washer for a little more than a week and am very pleased. I ordered it on Friday, August 19, 2016 and it was delivered Tuesday, August 23, 2016 by 10:00 AM.

This replaces the basic Panda washer I bought in January 2013 (https://www.amazon.com/Package-Panda-Portable-Compact-Capacity/dp/B005GM942C/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&qid=1472653538&sr=8-3&keywords=panda+washer). That washer was a workhorse for us. It's basically a 5 gallon bucket with an agitator at the bottom but it got the clothes clean. It lasted more than 3 1/2 years and was money well spent.

The Della mini compact washing machine is a definite upgrade for us. I really enjoy using it. I put it through it's paces from the start. I did 10 loads of clothes in the first 3 days (we went without a washer for several weeks and had been washing in the sink. I wasn't convinced our current clean clothes were actually clean, so I rewashed).

Unlike most users, I am able to connect the small hose to my kitchen faucet. For some reason, a previous tenant removed the aerator on my basic kitchen faucet and it's never been replaced. Because the aerator is removed, I'm able to connect the hose and use the clip to secure it. It takes a minute to get the right placement, but once it's on, it's a solid hold.

All of the details work as promised. The water pump removes the water, the spin dryer gets the clothes nearly dry and the clothes are very clean. I enjoy knowing I'm fully rinsing my c

My first impression of this was that it looked like a cheap child's toy, and I really didn't even want to try with it. Now that I have given it a go, and it has really cleaned and rung out a whole work uniform in 30 minutes I am mightily impressed. The owners manual is junk; so you'll need to read the reviews and use trial and error to find what works. Just fill it with a bucket, by the way.
Works good. The lint trap doesn't seem to do anything. You'll definitely need a lint roller. Pump needs to be primed often which I discovered on my own.
I love this little washing machine! It is very convenient and portable!

The machine is excellent........

It does not have a dryer, but the spin cycle leaves them fairly dry & ready to hang outdoors.........lThey will dry fast on a sunny day....

You can just lift the entire machine & place it in the bathtub or next to your kitchen sink....... You will be able to fill it up with cold or hot water with the provided fill hose........You will be able to drain the water into the bathtub or the kitchen sink with the other provided drain hose.....

The washing machine has to be lifted up onto the adjacent table to the kitchen sink.....Otherwise, it will not be able to drain if the sink is HIGHER than the washing machine........

I cannot rate their longevity...........Apparently nobody else can either.......All reviews are recent.......

If the washing machine breaks next week, my 5 star review becomes 1 star.....

I do not work for any washing machine company & I paid full price for this item.........I have had it for about 3 months now......

You can call Daniel at 312.877.9359 to ask me anything you want.......
this little thing is perfect for the apartment. the only downfall is when filling the hot water. the water hose comes off of the faucet. I wish it was on wheels but. it's not that heavy.
Its a great machine, but you have to prime the pump after every load.

It's worth the money I live in a small apartment in which no one is allow to have a washer machine and no one in the building know I have one no noise or nothing I save a bunch of money by not going to the laundromat anymore so I save my self 40.00 a week . It's a plus!!!! I would totally recommended this to anyone ❤

I did not know it was so easy to wash clothes and almost dry clothes in really about the same time as using a full size washer. You can put just about the same amount it this tiny washer as a regular size washer. If you think your clothes are clean after you wash in a regular size washer. Wait till you use this washer. The first load I washed were whites. I looked at the water in the tub it was nasty. These clothes are the clothes that I wear to my teaching job. I knew they could not be that dirty. But they were. Best washer I have ever used. I recommend it for anyone to use.
Definitely would recommend to buy :), super easy to use.
very nice

My della portable washer arrived today, and at this moment so to speak, I am currently using it, it a bit smaller than I anticipated..It's very light so I can move it easily...So far its working fine...I tried using the washer and the spinner at the same time..It did work fine, but while using both, the excess water that came from the spinner became stagnant under the bottom of the spinner...So Im guessing while using the spinner, you really have to put it on drain mode...Will update in a few days....

Love this machine!! you do need a lint thing to help with that but I am completely happy with my purchase. it really cleans the clothes and the spin dryer leaves them just a little damn. Definitely worth the money to me.
Thats is good one have no complains

This has been by far one of the best purchases I have made for the money within a long time. The machine works great. The machine pays for itself in 6 weeks for me and does an excellent job with clean. I have a walkin shower so it's ideal for me. I was tired of going to laundrymat and getting half way clean clothes. Now I have the best of both worlds.

Ps dryer means spin dry and not hand in your closet dry. Much better than regular washer but not dryer dry.

Washes small loads well.  Spin dry works very nice.  Cloths come out slightly damp.  Very happy with the purchase.  Only down side is lint.  The lint catcher on the machine doesnt do ne thing but there are little lint catchers out there to buy.  Also i have to lift the machine and flip it over to empty the remainer of water left in the washer that the drainage pump doesnt get.

I love this thing! I just got it three days ago, and it has made my clothes cleaner than a big automatic machine or even hand washing does!
The spinner is absolutely wonderful. It spins almost all of the water out. They are almost completely dry. They take about one to two hours to hang dry. Depending on how heavy the fabric is.
I just cannot say enough good things about it.
I am 5'7" and it comes up to the middle of the top of my legs and my hips. It's very light.
It is pretty quiet, my neighbors can't hear a thing.

I do a pair of jeans, three long sleeve shirts, three pairs of socks and a couple pairs of underwear, all in one load. They move freely and I could probably add more, but I just stick to that.

I did wash a jacket and it only took two hours to hang dry!

Great little washer/spiner for the price. If you're tired of going to the laundrymat and watching out for all the creepy people that come in, this is for you. Compact, lightweight, and cleans really well. If you don't mind a little work on your part, I would recommend this washer.  It holds alot. Teashirts & jeans no problem. Towels no problem. Sheets & pillowcases turned out great. Agitator in washer really churns the load. You may have to perodically stop the cycle to untangle your clothes. Drain pump really works.  To rinse your clothes just drain soapy water, add fresh water run a short cycle, drain & repeat.  Spinner really extracts alot of water.  Dries on the line in no time. Lightweight, I can store the unit in another room and move into the bathroom to use.  Auto Drain function works best if draining into a shower or walk-in bathtub. Though easily lifted for complete draining when ready to store. Yes, you will do some of the work, but considering the alternatives & expense, this is a good product. Size is perfect for an RV, dorm room or apartment.

I bought this on the spur of the moment since I live alone. It works well and I love it. The only thing that holds it back from a 5 star rating is from time to time it doesn't drain right away and I have to tilt it and then it starts working again.
Have for a month, working good no problem
Works well for the most part. A few issues with it draining all the way but overall a great little washer for the price.

I purchased this little machine in August of 2016.  It is now February of 2017, and the machine is working great. I usually do about 3 or 4 loads of laundry per week.  This machine works great and gets the clothes really clean.  I am able to wash a set of full sheets and pillowcases in one load.  I can also wash about 3 towels at a time.  As mentioned in another post, you sometimes have to move the control knob from normal to drain and back to drain in order to prime it.  I drain it into the toilet and 98% of the time it works fine, but once in a while, it needs to be primed.  I would definitely purchase this again.
Bought this for my mother-in-law to use in her apartment.  It's very practical.  According to her, it washes really well and dries even better.  She loves it!
Don't use that much

I bought this machine in Dec 2016 and I loved it for the first 3 months. In March 2017 the pump stopped working. I tried to prime it that wasn't the issue. Thankfully I got the extra insurance coverage. I contacted the insurance company on their website and filed a claim. I have to wait a maximum of 8 days for a response from them . So I am currently waiting to see if they will fix it, or give me a new product or give me credit to buy a new one, So we will see what happens.

A few things I noticed about the machine. Make sure you clean around the top hinges they can get really dirty. Also by the spin dryer if you move it to the side and look down on the right said it can get pretty nasty under there so make sure you spray it down or put bleach water in it which should help. I wouldn't buy a built in pump one again.
It didn't even last a year. Glad I got insurance. The manufacturers warranty is worthless. The pump just stopped working.
Great!

Had this washer/dryer for over a year with no problems.Gets clothes really and dries really well.I was able to get with Christmas money.So glad no more laundromat.Was able to wash a queen size blanket.Didn't fit in dryer so hung it up outside to dry.
Works great on small loads for daughter in her apartment
It is great.  It works just at good as the one I have at my home.  I would buy this again.

Update, July, 8th. 2017

So I have had this little gem for just over a month now. Within that time I have washed EVERYTHING from my work clothes, to throw rugs. I still do not have one bad thing to say about this product. As long as you do not try to OVER load it, or do too many things at once. I promise you will not be disappointed. I would highly recommend this product to anyone living tiny. Simply stated. I LOVE IT.

So I got this thing last week. Was a little stunned at just how small it actually was, not to mention how light it is to move around? So over this weekend, I have put this thing to the test. I live in a tiny house. *350 sq ft* so this thing it PERFECT for me. Where I had it placed when I first started using it was in my living room. Was putting water in with a 5 gal bucket, and draining the water out in the same bucket. Now doing it like this isn't advised. Although it has a discharge pump. It isn't a very strong one, and it struggles to get the water out. Now I set it in my bathroom, let the drain hose rest in my stand up shower floor, and it drains just fine. Filling it is much better also. I have a handheld shower head, so I just rest it in the unit and let it rip tater chip. All in all. This thing is worth what I paid for it. Like I said, I've only had it a week. So I will update you all if I have any problems.

Very satisfied with the washer. It's quieter than my stackable was in my previous apartment. Washes great. Spin dries great. The load size is just right for me.  And as I have limited space, the size is perfect.
Working just fine so far in the past few weeks. Hose fits my sink. I recommend buy a floating filter. Also read other reviews for recommendation, they were very helpful to me.

I received the washer in great timing. It is very good quality and works so well! I just wish the tubes and power cord were longer. The inlet tube actually fits on my bathroom sink. Ill get an extension cord and it will work perfectly for me. Awesome product!

Update 08/15/2019
Changing to 3 star from 5. The drain pump stopped working awhile ago and the spinner will not spin anymore. I have the Assurant Protection Plan and the website cant locate it. Of course...Luckily i have the email still.

I was not really sure what to expect but I felt so many reviewers were happy and satisfied I couldn't go wrong. I LOVE THIS MACHINE!!
Would give it 10 stars if I could. My only criticism is it refers often to water levels and none of us who looked could find any level markings within the tub. It is perfect size for my needs. I am somewhat disabled and to be able to wash a few things within the bathroom, where we placed it with easy access to water and drainage.

It also does a great job with everything I have washed. I am amazed how dry things are after spinning. Just a really great machine.

The Washing machine works great, the spin dry side spin's cloths dryer then any full sized I have ever used.  You have to be careful that it's even or it will shake the machine like crazy. Losses one star because even though It has a pump it takes some work to get it to start draining after any water comes out the end its good to go and will pump no matter where you have the hose, also the spin dry soap rinsing connection to run water through the spin dryer to remove soap reside leaks ever so slightly. So I end up with a small puddle on my bathroom floor every time I do a load. Over all very good and perfect for apartment living.

Can't complain. It does what it says it does. I used it inside the bathtub because I don't have washing machine deains in my place. Clothes come out almost dry. After hanging everything is dry within an hour.

I loved this machine from the second it got to our apartment, but it no longer works as it should. It was delivered to us on June 22, which was our first use (Which worked amazing.) It's load size is small, so we would be doing laundry every couple of days or as needed. Today is July 17th, and not only did the drain pump stop working last week, there is now an issue where water no longer stays in the one side, and will distribute itself to the spin dry side. (And won't drain from either.) I have read other reviews about the drain pump not working, but I figured I'd still give a go with this buy due to its affordability and the personal dread of hauling laundry down to the laundromat every so often.

So: I loved it, but that love was short lived

UPDATE 8/6/2017: Sooo, the drain pump is working again, and I figured out how to get it to work when it doesn't! I had to siphon from the end of the drain hose just a little, and the pump started working again! I guess the other side of the spin-dry tub was only getting filled when the pump failed to work on the wash side *Shrug*. With being able to wash clothes again, I give this machine more stars :D

Life changing and life saving! I can't explain enough how helpful this machine has been for my family and myself! I fell in love with an apartment that didn't have a washer/dryer connection and when I did research I figured I'd try a portable washer/dryer well this baby is going on a year strong without a single issue thus far and quite honestly it's paid for itself many times over for the amount of money it is to use a laundry facility for a year. The washing is fast and quiet. Dryer works  so well most clothes are dry to touch only needing a couple of hours hang time! Happy customer!

I've been using this machine for a couple of months now and I am absolutely happy with it! It is big enough for large loads but at the same time small enough for apartments. I keep it in my closet and move it to the bathroom when I need to do laundry. It washes very well with two cycles: normal and soft. The amazing part is the spring function. After 2-3 minutes of spinning the clothes come out almost dry. The machine is very quiet in operation, I can barely hear it from the next door room. I actually have to come into the bathroom to see if the cycle is over. The drainage pump is very useful as well, it helps make sure no water is left inside the machine when I am done with the laundry.

Overall, this is a very convenient product when you don't have time or energy to do laundry outside your apartment or if you don't want to spent the money and have your laundry done for you.

Great little machine, we use it for our travel trailer and it works very well. Found out that having enough water level is key to ensuring that clothes swirl correctly in the washer tub. Use very little soap. We wash on the 12 min setting and rinse for 9 min. Perfect for camping and much more convenient than using the coin laundry!
Best thing ever invented!!!!! Highly recommend!!!!!

This little washing machine is amazing, I totally love it.
It gets my clothes cleaner than a big top loader I used to use at the laundry.
I have noticed it gets clothes much cleaner, when switched on soft wash setting.
The spinner almost totally dries my clothes within 3 minutes.
I hang my clothes on a line inside my house, 5 minutes they are totally dry.
I totally recommend Della Mini Washing Machine.

Just as advertised.  Works extremely well for both wash and spin dry cycles.  You can hook up the water feed hose, or just fill it with a bucket.  Drain motor works extremely fast.  The spin is a MONSTER...this thing is like an industrial centrifuge!  It gets your clothes very dry and ready to hang.  Great deal.

Received my Della washer and did 4 loads this morning. Since I live in an upstairs apartment it is difficult for me to go up & down stairs to use the complex laundry room I'm 69 and I needed a better solution for doing my wash. After searching & reading reviews I decided to purchase the Della washer. I am over the moon satisfied. It's quiet, very quiet to my amazement and washes the clothes very clean. I would purchase this product again & again.

I have a smaller washer that was bought over a year ago just simple washer that I purchased due to small apartment and sits on the kitchen counter perfectly used it all the time down side no spin so I would have to wring clothes out by hand but better than going to laundry since me and my fiancé are retired takes a little more work but was fine with that then I saw this little beauty used it first time last night and let me say I'm in love it hand as the spin dry cycle and wow what a difference I have clothes racks I bought especially to hang clothes up to dry I had purchased one of the drier by Joy and those ddnt hold up I got rid of 2 of them that one was a replacement that quit working few days after I got it so I don't have a dryer so they hang dry but this was well worth it if you don't have the space or the means for a big regular washer folks if you are looking for something that is useable to help you out this is worth it you still have to do a little more than you would have to but to me the clothes come out great they are clean unlike using the laudry mats my fiances whites come out so white I cant say enough just remember this isn't a regular size washer you have to do a little more with this but hey to stay in my apt and do laundry and not have to leave is well worth it to me

I love this little machine....it is surprisingly good! I think the hoses could be better and some kind of adapter that is universal is needed. I am using my shower hose to fill it and this is working out well.

I also would like to know the customer service phone number as it is not in the booklet included with the machine?

I've had the Della Mini washer now for about 2 weeks and it has its pros and cons. The shipping was fast, I would say it took at least 4 days to come to my home. The machine itself is light weight and functions well. The bad news would be that it gives off a very weird odor once water is placed in the machine and while the machine dries out after use, and this happens every time I wash a load. In regards to the pump, the description says that there is a pump in the machine that helps drain the water, but you have to lay the hose completely flat on the floor in order to properly drain. Luckily I have a walk in shower in my apartment. It seems as if the pump isn't powerful enough to pump the water over a tub or even into a sink perhaps, even though the hose is long enough to do so. I've washed about 8 loads and the smell never gets on my garments, it just lingers in the air for awhile. The spinner is amazing, it dries my clothes 90-95%, and I just hang them on my collapsible drying rack for about 3 hours to completely dry.  Overall I will keep using the machine because its a lot better than toting around loads of laundry to the laundry mat.

i just got this today used it once i love it the only problem i have run in to is my first use i found out my drain hose has holes and leaks ... i wonder if theirs a way you get a replacement hose or if ill have to get another washer?
other then that it fits well in my apartment has a slight smell but its not all that bad
LOVE IT! I moved to a smaller home with no washer/dryer, found this, arrived the next day, WORKS GREAT!

This thing is AWESOME!!! Perfect for my apartment! Good size, it fits right in the bathroom where it's convenient to fill and drain it.  I just put the clothes, water and soap in, set the timer and let it wash. Drain the water, fill again with clean water to rinse, set the timer. Then at the end put everything in the spinner and it spins all the water out! It doesn't get like jeans and stuff 100% dry but gets them to where they are barely damp! Then I just hang them and let them dry the rest of the way. Took 20 minutes to complete my whole first load, which was a pair of work pants, a skirt, 2 pairs of leggings, socks, underwear, and a pair of sweatpants. I'm in love!!  In the photo is my cute little size reference, Brady!

I got this washer when it was on sale and a little lower in price. If we consider that price point this is 6 star. Pretty neat little washer/tumble dryer. Especially useful if you have toddler clothes to wash. I washed it as per recommendation but I could easily fit lot more clothes. clothes came out neat and dry from the dryer. Just hand it in front of your heater vent and should not be long before he clothes are completely dry. There are some expected shortcomings though : The water in pipe does not fit my faucet. The drain pipe is really small and could have been longer. A glass of water is still left even after draining using the inbuilt pump. Even then I would say for an apartment and for the price point this is a neat little washer/dryer combo.

This DELLA portable washing machine seems to work well so far!  I have tested it out with several loads- it has been able to get clothes clean as well as spin dry them successfully.  I am impressed at how quickly it washes and spin dries loads.  Some notes: I don't fill it up with the hose that comes attached- that is too small to fit on the faucets at my house.  I fill it up with a bucket or the shower head instead.  Also, though it has a drain pump, it is helpful to elevate the machine to enable the pump to get the last bit of water out.  Finally, as some other reviewers have noted, it does have leave an odd (plastic) smell in the air after use, but I put it away in my closet after use and then the smell goes away.  I purchased this machine in order to wash cloth diapers at home quickly, but baby isn't here yet, so I don't yet know how effective it will be at getting cloth diapers clean.  All indicators are positive, though!

Great little machine. Washes beautifully and spins clothes practically dry! Only downfall is hose for putting water in machine is cheap and flimsy and doesn't adapt to any water sources in my home. Also the instructions are written and illustrated terribly. But once you get the machine filled and figured out, you will enjoy how well it works.
This washer is totally awesome. I have been searching for one that would fit in my small space and not only does it fit perfectly but it cleans my clothes perfectly!

This little washer/spin dryer is great!  Just like the other reviews say it does not get your clothes completely dry, but like 85-90%.  It is a lot bigger than I expected it to be and washes a lot more than it seems on any of the videos I watched about it.  only thing is that I wish the hose that you use to get the water into the washer is a bit shorter than I would like, which made it hard to find a place to put this thing.  I ended up putting it in the bathroom beside the stand up shower.  I have to pour the water into the machine, which some people do anyway and it drains easily into the shower.  I love it. Its cute and fun to use.  I actually enjoy washing clothes now because of it.  Its like having an adult toy.

The shipping was quick but the machine left a lot to be desired. The hoses it comes with aren't long enough and they don't fit any sort of faucet. The draining of the machine is the biggest problem besides filling it because it never has enough power to get all the water drained without laying the hose literally flat into a bucket and doing that several times which is the most annoying thing ever. The machine itself washing the stuff and has an decent space to fit things but the process of filling with a bucket and draining with a bucket is dumb.
So far so good, works like a charm everytime and the spin cycle is awesome. The seller shipped it free and it came in no time at all. I'm very satisfied. .
Did not work at all. Return shipping for a refund was my responsibility and very expensive..

Well, for the most part it works well.  It cleans surprisingly well.  And it gets the clothes mostly dry, so that only a brief air drying is required.  However, there are a few design flaws with this unit.  First, the pump is not strong enough to actually pump water up any elevation at all.  Maybe in part do the the improper draining, residual soap and smell is also a problem.  We fixed this by running while sitting in the bathtub.  That seem to be the only way to get the unit to drain properly.

Washer works beautifully. However, a new pamphlet should be designed with clearer pictures and instructions. The existing pamphlet is useless.
And the fill hose is pretty funny.... Throw it out. The cord and drain hose should be a little longer. Still love the washer and how it performs and you cannot beat the price !

We bought this and during our six week camping trip it held up like a champ!  It has already saved us the cost of the machine.  I wish we were reps cause we could have sold several at our campgrounds.
A lot of work.

I love my new laundry gal 'Della'!  She does just what she is supposed to do-washes my clothes clean fast and spins them almost dry!  And very few wrinkles because most only spin for minute or so.  She is perfect in the motorhome shower!

We purchased this to use in our RV for extended trips.  I've been practicing using it at home before our trips and there is a learning curve after using a full size washer.  The machine cleans well but adding the correct amount of detergent takes trial and error.  The instruction booklet is written for someone who has used a machine like this before and not for new comers.  I am very pleased with this and think it is an excellent value for the price. We'll be leaving soon for a six week trip and are looking forward to cleaning our clothes with this machine.

I have only used it twice but it works great so far. The hose does fit on my sink to add water but I just use a bucket!  People have comment that it had a smell, but I like the smell.  It smells new. I can't believe how clean it gets my clothes.

Loving my Della mini washer. So. easy to use and fits perfectly in my apartment. My clothes come out clean and I feel safer not having to share machines at the laundromat.  My only problem is not knowing about this product earlier. Thank you.
Got this for my son. He loves it, said it washes really quick.
It works great...! but it needs an extra water fill hose and you can't find them in any hardware store. Still like it though.

I was able to go to a local hardware store and purchase a shower head diverter, shower hose, a male plastic nipple that screwed into the lower end of the shower hose. I then used a small hose clamp to fasten it to the provided hose received with the washer. No I can flip the diverter on the shower head, turn on the shower and fill the washer. I was  quite impressed with how much I could fit in that little thing at once. I would say I could fit approx half a load of a normal sized washer with no issues. And the spin section does a great job at spinning out excess water. I set the spinner for 5 minutes, run cold water in there for the first 2 in order to to get rid of all the soap, then turn off the water at 3 minutes remaining and just let it spin out. Clothes dry within an hour or two near a fan. I have thrown 8 loads in the washer so far with no issues. Time will tell! Yes, the machine does require some babysitting, by then again, so does a public laundromat!

Excellent value! Excellent purchase. This mini-washing machine really lives up to its reputation.

PROs:
First of all it is light so it can be moved from a storage location to an operation location. At only 30 lbs it is easy to keep in a shed and bring it out to do a load of clothes.

Second it holds more clothes than you think. The washer basked is large and seems to do an equal job whether it is full or mostly empty. The only negative is that the washer basket is so much larger than the spinner basket that you have to split up large wash loads into multiple spin loads.

Third it does a great job washing clothes with very little soap. We use about 1/2 Tbls of liquid detergent for a half basket of clothes (4 lbs). The clothes always come out clean.

Fourth is the power of the spinner. Wet clothes come out so close to dry that it really takes very little effort to finish the job. An hour or less on a rack in the sun and everything is dry.

Fifth is the price. At less than $100 this is the bargain of a lifetime. We found small desktop mini-washers that cost more and did far less.

CONs:
First is the drain pump. It does not have the power to lift the water up to the level of a normal washer-drain. We use it outside so this is not a problem as we just lay the drain hose on the ground. It works in a bathtub as well for the same reason.

Second is the instruction manual. Obviously translated (maybe mult
After a few washes, it stopped working. Don't buy it

We've had our Della for well over a month now. I have not noticed a "funny smell" from our (thankfully). This machine has paid for itself twice at least. We are a family of SEVEN. I use it for under garments, and tops mostly. I have washed a couple of pair of jeans and even a couple of towels without issue. The machine is quiet. We actually live in an upstairs unit, and have it sitting on two of the memory foam style bath mats and haven't had any noise issues....the neighbors downstairs actually told us they appreciate how quiet we are compared to the folks who live in this unit before us. haha....
I was able to get it to hook up to my kitchen sink to fill the wash tank...but the drain hose wouldn't reach the kitchen sink, so we drained it into a five gallon water jug. I got tired of lifting that jug, so moved it to the bathroom. Purchased a hand held shower head and now use that to fill the wash tank, and have it drain in to the tub...SO MUCH EASIER! This has been a wonderful investment for our family.

Really does a great job getting dirt and grime out of clothes. more work that a fully automatic washer, but definitely better than hand washing. I was really impressed with how much water the spinner gets out, clothes are only slightly damp and dry rather quickly. Uses alot of water, but we are using filtered rainwater so it balances out. DEFINITELY a better option than the laundromat and we are able to use the machine with our solar power.

Surprised me how well this small washer preformed. Well built with lots of agitating power. I recommend this product for all interested in a space saving washer with excellent qualities. Money well spent!
I like this mini washer.
Very nice

I'm loving my della washing machine. The only problem I have is that it's to loud,but other then that I difinitly give it 5 stars. 😁My friend told me about it and we're she got her' s from Amazon. I really don't shop online at all. How she was talking about the della washing machine I just had to have it. 💋
Meet my needs. packaging fine.Thank you 👍🏽
ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS.  It works perfectly in an apartment and washes very well.

WOW! I am super impressed! Fits a weeks worth of underwear and shirts in one load! The drain actually works with my clawfoot tub and hooks on perfectly but even if it didn't i could easily put casters on the bottom and roll it by the door to drain since i'm elevated here or like others have done, just use a bucket. it has an electrical pump to get the water out but i'm always thinking of (just in case scenarios). The cord is pretty short so i have to swing it out when i want to use it but it's ony 30lbs so super easy to do. It only takes a teaspoon of liquid detergent to get super sudsy. the water inlet thing could be used (it looks like a funnel so i'm not sure how it's supposed to secure to anything) but I just hang my detachable shower hose to fill it up. it doesn't take long at all and it has fill lines so you know when to stop. If you don't have a shower hose you can use a couple of pots of water instead. The spinner is really great and gets clothes almost dry. i've been doing about a month's worth of laundry with it since i unboxed it three hours ago and i'm almost done. it was very painless. Does not leak (ignore the part of the instructions where it says turn to drain before starting. don't do that. it's very messy lol. When it's not in drain the floor stays dry lol. Washer really works great (look at the before and after photos of the water).  VERY GLAD I BOUGHT THIS.

Great little machine for small loads.  Extra steps to wash, rinse and spin, but worth the trouble. Spin cycle extracts water to the point that clothes are almost dry. Only have to go to laundromat 1x a month for big items and towels.
This is not a dryer, it just rings the clothes out which you manually have to do everything, faster and more effoecent to wash it by hand!

This is a great machine for a small apartment, it fits in a small storage closet and is really light weight. I recommend that you put it in the bathtub or shower since the water pump is not that strong it needs to be flat on the ground or if possible even on a lower level than the washing machine.. I put it flat on the ground and it works OK. if you don't do this the pump will not be capable of pumping out all the water!. Don't put in too much clothes cause it won't wash it correctly.. Put it in by steps, I recommend washing at least once a week to not have more than 2 washing cycles. I live with my husband and I mostly do 3-4 cycles per week, but we are gym goers so that makes more dirty laundry than normal.. I also always wash towels and sometimes even bed covers and things like that. The centrifuge is awesome! It really takes the juice out of the clothes!. The only problem is that as soon as you have it filled and start the centrifuge cycle you have to hold the centrifuge corner of the machine down (I just gently "sit" on it for 5 seconds) because of not the machine is going to take almost 20 seconds if not more to get a grip and not jump around like crazy! This sounds funny but it's loud and annoying so just do the trick and you'll be fine. To fill the washing part with water I always fill approx. 3 buckets of water and manually out them into the machine... Because I have the machine in the bathtub the water tube just doesn't reach the sink cause it's too short..

Doesn't clean well.... You have to wash 5 times to get rags and clothes "clean" for the price it does what it says soi can't complain too much. The drying side doesn't dry so it's a bit misleading, it just spins water out ... You have to line dry afterwards. Neat for camping trips.

What I do not like is that water just sits in the bottom.... So it smells a little when not used daily.
